short: In 2026 counters in municipal administrations work in a national database, in the 11 municipalities of one province; the national count is not known.

short: A 2021 strategy plans fibre to the communes and one commune's connection was announced in 2024; whether any commune office is connected is not known.

short: All councils had the government's finance system by late 2024 and most used it; capped because no current plan or budget line is known.

short: No sector administration, nor the Bissau municipal chamber, is known to have an office connection in 2026, so no stage is set.

short: All 47 counties were on the government network by 2017 and work in national systems; how many county offices are connected is not known.

short: The mayors of 21 municipalities were given access to the ministry's online systems in October 2025; how many municipal offices are connected is not known.
gaps: The newest coverage fact is the October 2025 access given to the mayors of 21 municipalities to the ministry's electronic systems, a count with no total, and it says access was given, not that the offices work in the systems over their own connection; the only account of the offices' connections is a 2021 case study of three authorities. short: A revenue system was deployed in 969 of 1,590 local authorities of all tiers by 2020; how commune offices are connected is not known.

short: Government counted 93 of 116 councils on its network in 2025 and all 116 in March 2026; the rural share is not known.
gaps: No figure gives the rural share, so the 116 of 116 that Smart Zambia stated in March 2026 cannot reach stage 5. That figure disagrees with later facts: Sinazongwe Town Council was reported as receiving its connection in August 2026 under a programme that still 'seeks to connect' all 116 councils, and North-Western Province's councils were announced connected in July 2026; the budget address of September 2025 counted 93 of 116. Use in a national system is not stated in so many words as done at the council office (the CDF system's data entry 'across councils', and a 2023 survey's e-procurement), and the financing is the plan's stated intention, not a budget line for council connections.

short: Government handed over 250 satellite kits for local authorities in 2025; whether any council office is connected is not known.
gaps: No row says a local authority's office is connected and in use: the 250 Starlink kits of July 2025 were handed over with installation still to come, the 104 Masvingo kits are one total for schools, clinics and local authorities with no council count and no statement that they are activated, and Manyame's connection is not said to be live. No plan naming the connection of local authorities is held, the domestic finance is one council's own budget (the national donation's finance is not stated), and no national count or share of councils connected is published.
